thread:
Jules (CS): Quick flag  LightHaven Labs (acct: LH-204) dropped ~86% in embed+gen calls starting 2026-09-02. Renewal 2026-11-10. New ML lead Priyanka joined 9/1; procurement mentioned a short pilot with AeroNet. Need fast triage.
Marta (AM): Oof. Can you paste the usage snapshot and any auth/errors? I'll ping Priyanka & procurement.
Jules (CS): Small query + result:
```sql
SELECT date, sum(calls) as calls
FROM api_usage
WHERE client_id='LH-204' AND date >= '2026-08-25'
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;
-- 2026-09-01 calls=10,210; 2026-09-02 calls=1,380; 2026-09-03 calls=1,050
```
Jules (CS): No 401/403 surge, but alerts-bot flagged a big drop and a change in client SDK version usage on 9/2.
alerts-bot: Detected anomaly for LH-204: calls -86%, client_sdk v2.3 -> v3.0 adoption spike at 2026-09-02, latency stable.
Rene (Solutions): Interesting  I'll grep request payloads for embed flags and look for any client-side opts. If they flipped to local-embed=true in the SDK, that would explain fewer embed calls. Starting trace now.
Samir (Onboarding): If it's a prompt/SDK change, offer a 30-min tune + integration sanity check. I can do Tue/Wed mornings PT.
Marta (AM): I'll DM Priyanka to confirm whether the change is intentional. Keep the tone consultative.
Rene (Solutions): Quick trace: found many requests after 2026-09-02 with header X-SDK-Feature: local-embeddings=true and payload param embed_run=false. Example log line:
2026-09-02T15:04:12Z req id=abc user=LH-204 sdk=v3.0 header=X-SDK-Feature: local-embeddings=true payload(embed_run)=false
Rene (Solutions): That lines up. Looks like their team upgraded the SDK and enabled a feature that routes embedding generation to a local transformer, lowering calls to our embeddings API.
Jules (CS): That explains the drop and means it's not necessarily a procurement loss yet. Still a renewal risk if AeroNet offers lower operational overhead. Suggest we offer a cost/latency comparison and an enablement session to show value of our embeddings (quality + ops tradeoffs).
Marta (AM): Priyanka replied: they rolled the SDK to v3.0 to test local embed caching but want to validate quality vs AeroNet. She asked if we can run a 3-query quality + cost comparison using their prompts and offer a short trial extension to re-run pipelines.
Samir (Onboarding): I'll prepare a short checklist: 1) diff SDK config (local-embeddings flag), 2) suggested toggle back steps, 3) prompt parity checks. Can host Tue 9am PT.
Rene (Solutions): If they share 3 representative prompts we can run: 1) embed similarity quality check, 2) token-cost projection if they keep remote embeddings, 3) end-to-end latency numbers. 24h turnaround after prompts.
Marta (AM): Owners: Marta (exec outreach + procurement), Jules (monitor + logs), Rene (bench & quality), Samir (enablement). I'll add CS ticket CS-8533 and schedule renewal watch for 2026-10-25.
Jules (CS): Draft outreach note I sent to Priyanka (consultative): "Hi Priyanka  saw SDK roll to v3.0 and local-embeddings enabled on 9/2. If you're comparing quality or ops tradeoffs with AeroNet, happy to run a 3-query quality + token-cost comparison on your prompts and extend the trial for 2 weeks to let you re-run pipelines. Also we can pair on toggling configs safely. No commitment.  Jules"
Marta (AM): Priyanka accepted the session and will share prompts after our call. Tentative Tue 9am PT booked.
Rene (Solutions): I'll prepare the perf + quality harness and include a small embed-nearest-neighbor A/B using their sample set. Will report back with numbers within 48h of prompts.
Samir (Onboarding): Invite sent. I'll include a one-page guide for toggling local-embeddings off safely and SDK snippet for fallback to remote embeddings.
Jules (CS): Monitoring continues. If procurement speeds up, escalate for an exec perf demo. Thanks team :thumbsup:
